title: privacy: Private/internal product names (goala, sitches, fitkind, univiirse, vivii, up2much, StrikeThePose, settle…
description:
[P1 · privacy · audit] Private/internal product names (goala, sitches, fitkind, univiirse, vivii, up2much, StrikeThePose, settle) are baked into shipping code and docs across 23 tracked files. Most damaging: simemu/swift/Sources/SimEmuBar/SimEmuApp.swift:87 contains a LIVE hardcoded allowlist `["goala","sitches","fitkind","vivii","univiirse","up2much"]` used for project-name inference (also a latent bug — community members' projects won't match). Also in simemu/discover.py:339, simemu/cli.py:2176/2246, simemu/state.py:4-9 (help/docstrings), README.md:88, AGENTS.md:207-208, docs/shared-desktop-plan.md:40-41, PRODUCT_IT_WAS_MEANT_TO_BE.md:58.

Evidence: git grep -liE 'goala|fitkind|sitches|univiirse|strikethepose' → 23 files; SimEmuApp.swift:87 `for name in ["goala", "sitches", "fitkind", "vivii", "univiirse", "up2much"]`

Fix: Replace hardcoded private product names with generic examples (e.g. 'myapp', 'demo-ios'); make the Swift project-inference list config-driven (read from ~/.simemu/config.json) instead of a hardcoded allowlist.

Source: launch-readiness audit 2026-06-18
